claims: lean/VALID7.md says the generated Sqpack/V7/Main.lean proves theorem valid7 : Bentz.Valid7, theorem bentz : ∀ k : ℕ, 6 ≤ k → minSide (k ^ 2 - 3) = k (Bentz.bentz_of_valid7 valid7) and theorem validTilt7 : Bentz.ValidTilt7, in namespace SquarePacking.LemmaELeaf, each depending on axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], with no sorry, no native_decide and no new axiom.

The 9,800 per-root certificates, one pickle per root of the k2m3 tree from scripts/run_v7.py, are not in the repository but in the release data/valid7-lean-certs-v1 as v7cert.tar.zst with v7cert.sha256; scripts/gen_main.py names root i Sqpack.V7.R{i:05d} and glues the roots of run V3 over the D4 root [0, 7/2]^2 x (0, 1/2].

VALID7.md reports the build on 64-core, 512 GB machines (at most 55 lean processes each): all 9,800 roots passed; Face 9 min (47 GB), Bridge 7 min (24 GB), Main 2 min 17 s (58 GB); the root checks are the bulk of the cost, roughly 10^4 CPU-hours in total.
